title: Dancing Dolls
subtitle: Down the first cup, then the second, and the third. Don't stop drinking!

items.text: The curtain of night has already fallen, but even after drinking another cup of tea promised to induce drowsiness, Yenisei finds that sleep evades her.
In theory, someone so heavily fatigued, should fall fast asleep the very moment the opportunity presents itself. But not for her.
On the contrary, her mind, so sick with worries, seems to run faster now than ever in the stillness of night.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: *sighs*
She stands up, steps away from the couch, and treads lightly down the stairs.
Unwelcome in even her own dreams, she wanders around without direction.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: The yard ... Go downstairs and through the main hall ...
Groping around for the railing in the darkness, she walks up and then down the steps.
One step, another step ... As she descends, a rustling sound envelops her in the darkness, like an indelible point that demands her whole focus.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Hmm? What's that sound ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Where does it come from?
By the flowers in the snow, raise a toast and don't say no.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Who is it? Someone's ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: ... singing?
Without realizing it, she departs the second floor and follows the sound into the spacious hall of the tavern.
With the cascading moonlight and melodious singing, the scene laid out before her is one that defies description.
By the flowers in the snow, raise a toast and don't say no.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: The striped horses—how come they are ... glowing?!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: What on earth is happening?!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Gosh!
With its red mane and luminous stripes, the "horse" stands there in the courtyard and turns gently toward her.
The singing continues, almost freezing Yenisei in place. She turns around sharply, trying to escape the sound, only to realize that she has already been surrounded ...
… by the group of wooden dolls who were in her cup earlier.

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: By the flowers in the snow, raise a toast and don't say no.

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: Fill your cup, fill your cup!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Are they ... asking me to drink?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Jiǔ Niángzǐ! Where are you?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Is she ...
Now, the wooden dolls, originally submerged in the stream in the courtyard, have begun to climb up the bank.
They surround her, spinning, singing, and contorting, with bodies clearly possessing a flexibility beyond what wood should possess.
Using this odd flexibility, they repeatedly lift their full cups toward Yenisei.

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: No turning down, no turning down!

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: No ...
This invitation, perhaps initially hospitable, turns increasingly creepy in the dark night.
Making a choice now requires next to no thought. Yenisei jumps out from their enclosure and runs toward the other end of the yard—toward the water jar.
Fortunately, she clearly remembered the location pointed out by Jiǔ Niángzǐ.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: I can't go back to my room. Need to lead them away.
The wooden dolls still sing happily, as if they are only playing a game of tag.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Ugh!
The wooden dolls stage a disorganized offensive, with a piercing song that twists Yenisei's perception of her surroundings.
She can only stand by the water jar, in a constant retreat, consciously nearing a dead end.

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: *sound of wood rubbing*

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: Clack. Clack. Clack.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: No ...

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Can't stop here. I must go ... farther.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Come here! This way!
The wooden figures have no ears, so it seems unlikely they hear or understand her.
Nonetheless, they are lured in, leaping forward with strange enthusiasm.
Never tiring. Just like those cups, always lifted high, constantly spilling and overflowing.

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: *sound of wood rubbing*
It seems these crude wooden creations are quick to be alert to sudden interlopers.
They immediately stop their siege of Yenisei and abruptly turn toward the tall trees in the courtyard.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Hmm? Where are they going?

items.speaker: Wooden Dolls
items.text: Clack! Clack!
The coercive rhythm plays heavier and faster than before, as they jump a few more hops toward the bottom of the tree—
Be off!
A wand of bone flies out from the darkness, scattering liquor and shattering the wooden figures into pieces.
Serenity comes back to the scene, the end coming as swiftly as its beginning.
They are conjured ...
... so feebly.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Who ... Who is it?!
Hmm?
It's you?

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: You? The feather man who stole our horses!
No matter. You're leaving with me.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Leave me alone! What is going on?
Silence. It's dangerous here, and words are no help to us.
Without hesitation, the giant bird grabs Yenisei's arms quickly, lifting her up and away from the courtyard.
Her struggle proves futile in the howling wind.

items.speaker: Yenisei
items.text: Aaaah!
The sound of flapping wings punctuated by the shrieking girl gradually fades in the distance, leaving only a disordered mess as evidence in the courtyard.
In the morning, Jiǔ Niángzǐ walks into the shambolic scene.
A still-intact wooden doll bounces around, gathering the remains of its kind into a ball.

items.speaker: Wooden Doll
items.text: Alas, alas. An arm is missing. Can't put them together, anymore.

items.speaker: Wooden Doll
items.text: Late. You are late.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What's going on?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I told you to keep the house, not to tear it down.

items.speaker: Wooden Doll
items.text: Being, a, good host. Offering, a drink.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Offer a drink to whom?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Those two ladies should be soundly asleep upstairs.

items.speaker: Wooden Doll
items.text: One, was downstairs, at night. Bird man, with her.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Bird man ... You mean that feather man? He had been here?!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What was he doing here? He's not even a Xiángruì, nor is he doing anything good. Do not offer a drink to him!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Humph. If I were the one treating him, I would ...

items.speaker: Wooden Doll
items.text: He took one, with him.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I would ... I, wait, what?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Took whom with him??

items.speaker: Wooden Doll
items.text: The scarlet. The brown, took away, the scarlet.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Brown? Scarlet? What color is that?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: *sighs* You're just confusing me. I'll make you one more mouth next time. What on earth are you talking about.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Hiss ...
Jiǔ Niángzǐ turns around to see Bessmert fall over the threshold.
She quickly approaches with her skirt held up, and the wooden doll jumping up and down, hiding behind her.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Be careful! I'll help you.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Thank you. Thank you so much.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Where's Yenisei? Did you see her upstairs or in the yard?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Are you talking about your red-haired friend? Did she go out?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: No, not very likely. She would have told me if she was going out. Or at least ask someone to pass on the message.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Did you really not see her today?
Jiǔ Niángzǐ racks her brain, her voice coming out serious and resolute.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: No, not this morning, no.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: The missing persons cases! Is this how they happened?!

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I-I don't know. Lǐzhèng didn't make it in time to tell me the details ...
Bessmert falls into silence. This is a loss that she finds difficult to accept.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: If—I'm only saying—if this is another missing case, there must be a clue or two telling us what happened.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Could you please look around and see if she has left anything in the yard? She must have been taken from there, or I would have definitely heard the noises.
Bessmert anxiously grasps Jiǔ Niángzǐ's hands. Their hands are equally coarse—one pair exposed to age and sun, and the other exposed to grueling work.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Stay calm. Let's go ask Lǐzhèng.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Wait ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: What's wrong?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: I sense an arcane energy. Someone cast a skill in the yard.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Follow me.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Where are you going? You can't see! Just tell me. I'll take you there.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: No, please follow me.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: You're heading toward the water jar. I was here last night to get water.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: It's somewhere close to the water jar. I sense it clearly.
Bessmert wades through the stream and stops in front of the water jar. She crouches down to find something among the scattered leaves in front of her.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Is this a bone?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: That makes sense. Lǐzhèng told us that the feather man uses a bone wand. Yenisei also saw something similar in that giant bird's hand when we faced him outside the city.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I knew it! Now, we have the proof, we can ...

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: No, it's not enough. And Yenisei is missing.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Why not enough? He left his bone wand, which means he was here before. And your friend is missing! Still not enough to prove his guilt?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: But only Yenisei knows what the giant bird looks like. She also drew the picture of that bird.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Without her, we cannot confirm that the feather man and the giant bird are the same creature.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I don't understand. You're saying that, even if we have his bone wand, we can't prove anything?

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Exactly.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: But, I think you're overthinking.
Bessmert raises her head slightly, conveying her confusion in unsubtle movements.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I-I mean, whether enough or not, it's not up to us, right?

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I know nothing about the law. It ... it just doesn't feel right.
The girl's voice quietens down, giving rise to her own hesitation.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: I'm just thinking ... we should do something, because you are sad.
But Bessmert already understands.

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: You have a point. Then we ...

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Let's go to the Zhící now! Lǐzhèng will be there today. He is supposed to tell me something about the Dùshuò Festival.

items.speaker: Jiu Niangzi
items.text: Let's tell him what happened today. He will know what to do!

items.speaker: Bessmert
items.text: Sure.
They decided to head towards the Zhící. Bessmert puts away the bone wand and follows Jiǔ Niángzǐ's footsteps carefully, one at a time.
They leave the wooden doll standing in place, a sentinel atop the rest of the debris.
